chaudhary-beeri-singh-college-of-enginee.description: Chaudhary Beeri Singh College of Engineering and Management is a private engineering and management college at Peeli Pokhar on the Agra-Aligarh road.
chaudhary-beeri-singh-college-of-enginee.about: The college was established in 2009 by the Ch. Beeri Singh Siksha Samiti, Agra. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to the state technical university at Lucknow (formerly UPTU, now AKTU). It offers engineering programmes including electronics and communication and mechanical engineering.
chaudhary-beeri-singh-college-of-enginee.address: Peeli Pokhar, Agra-Aligarh Road, Agra, Uttar Pradesh
chaudhary-beeri-singh-college-of-enginee.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

dayalbagh-educational-institute.description: Dayalbagh Educational Institute is a deemed-to-be university at Dayalbagh, Agra, whose Faculty of Engineering grew out of the Dayalbagh Engineering College founded in 1950.
dayalbagh-educational-institute.about: The Government of India declared DEI a deemed university under Section 3 of the UGC Act on 16 May 1981. Its Faculty of Engineering began in 1950 as Dayalbagh Engineering College and became part of the institute in 1981. The campus is at Dayalbagh in Agra.

dr-bhimrao-ambedkar-university.description: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University, formerly Agra University, is a state university in Agra accredited by NAAC with an A+ grade.
dr-bhimrao-ambedkar-university.about: The university was established on 1 July 1927 as Agra University and is one of the oldest universities in India. Its administrative office is at Paliwal Park, Agra. It runs an Institute of Engineering and Technology at its Khandari campus and holds a NAAC A+ grade.

faculty-of-engineering-and-technology-r-.description: The Faculty of Engineering and Technology at R.B.S. College, Bichpuri, is an engineering campus near Agra run by the Balwant Educational Society.
faculty-of-engineering-and-technology-r-.about: The faculty started in 1996 with computer science, electronics and communication, and food technology, and added chemical engineering in 1999. It is governed by the Balwant Educational Society, chaired by the District and Sessions Judge of Agra. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (college code 004), and its B.Tech and M.Tech courses are AICTE approved.
faculty-of-engineering-and-technology-r-.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

faculty-of-engineering-and-technology-ag.description: The Faculty of Engineering and Technology is the engineering wing of Agra College, a historic college on Mahatma Gandhi Road in Agra.
faculty-of-engineering-and-technology-ag.about: The faculty is part of Agra College, which was founded in 1823. It is recognised by AICTE and offers B.Tech programmes in computer science, mechanical, civil and electrical engineering, plus an M.Tech. It is located on Mahatma Gandhi Road in Agra.
faculty-of-engineering-and-technology-ag.address: Mahatma Gandhi Road, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282001

institute-of-engineering-and-technology-.description: The Institute of Engineering and Technology, Agra is the engineering institute of Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University at its Khandari campus.
institute-of-engineering-and-technology-.about: IET Agra is an integral part of Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University (formerly Agra University). It is located at the Khandari campus and is approved by AICTE. It runs departments of computer science, electronics and communication, mechanical, civil and electrical engineering.

neelam-college-of-engineering-and-techno.description: Neelam College of Engineering and Technology is part of the Neelam Group of Institutions in Agra, offering B.Tech and allied programmes.
neelam-college-of-engineering-and-techno.about: The Neelam Group of Institutions was established in 2008. Its B.Tech programme is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and approved by AICTE. It offers mechanical, civil, computer science and electrical engineering.
neelam-college-of-engineering-and-techno.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

acn-college-of-engg-and-managment-studie.description: ACN College of Engineering and Management Studies is the flagship college of the ACN Group of Institutions at ACN City, Aligarh.
acn-college-of-engg-and-managment-studie.about: The college was established in 2008 on a campus of about 100 acres. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. It offers B.Tech and management programmes.
acn-college-of-engg-and-managment-studie.address: ACN City, Qasimpur Power House Road, Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh 202002
acn-college-of-engg-and-managment-studie.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

aligarh-college-of-engineering-and-techn.description: Aligarh College of Engineering and Technology is a private engineering college on the Aligarh-Mathura Road, about 3 km from Aligarh city.
aligarh-college-of-engineering-and-techn.about: ACET was set up in 2001 by the Jawahar Vidyalaya Society. Its courses are affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and approved by AICTE. It offers B.Tech in seven disciplines, including agricultural engineering, along with MBA and MCA programmes.
aligarh-college-of-engineering-and-techn.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

institute-of-technology-and-management-3.description: Institute of Technology and Management, Aligarh is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college on the Aligarh-Palwal-Delhi Road at Karsua.
institute-of-technology-and-management-3.about: The college began in the 2008-09 academic session. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University with college code 341. Its campus is at Karsua on the Aligarh-Palwal-Delhi Road.
institute-of-technology-and-management-3.address: Aligarh-Palwal-Delhi Road, Karsua, Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh 202140
institute-of-technology-and-management-3.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow
